scope: Single-page Settings, shared borderless fields, desktop select chevrons, Change photo upload/paste chooser

indexes.normalization: Expand default __name__ ordering; default ttl false; sort field overrides.

deploymentScope: Firebase Hosting only; no Functions, rules, indexes, schema or production data changes
coverageLimits: Browser checks use synthetic accounts and telemetry with Firebase requests disabled.
Clipboard content/permission outcomes are simulated; physical OS/device clipboard behaviour remains a manual check.
Settings retains the existing server contract that does not support clearing a previously set presentation or public link.
